aim.name: Annals of Internal Medicine
aim.title_selectors: h1.citation__title, .citation__title, .article-header h1, .article__title, main h1, article h1
aim._note: TOC URL switched 2026-05-12 from /toc/aim/current to /latest/aim. The new endpoint is a continuous-publication listing that stacks several recent issues under h2.section-header__title date headings (e.g. '12 May 2026'); bundler.parse_toc passes issue_date so parseAIM_TOC filters to the matching date group. Each issue-item on /latest/aim already carries a listing briefing in div.issue__item__abstract — this is captured into the new `listing_brief` field on each TOC row, separate from the per-article-page abstract that extractArticle pulls. Letters group under issue-item--with__letters wrappers; multi-letter weeks fan out to one article per div.issue-item__letter.

nejm.name: New England Journal of Medicine
nejm._routine_note: NEJM full-media policy: every article + every audio + every video + every supplementary PDF is ingested. Requires a logged-in subscriber session.

jama.name: JAMA
jama._podcast_note: fetch_podcast_transcripts=true: bundler scans each article body for jamanetwork.com/learning/audio-player/<id> URLs; for each, podcast_bundler.fetch_and_bundle drives the browser to the AMA EdHub transcript page and writes a podcast bundle under $JOURNAL_PODCAST_ROOT/<show>/<year>/<episode>/. Show inference: transcript intro regex (JAMA Editor's Summary / Clinical Reviews / Medical News etc.) + container article section fallback.

jamaoto.name: JAMA Otolaryngology-Head & Neck Surgery
jamaoto._note: JAMA Otolaryngology-Head & Neck Surgery. Same jamanetwork.com Atypon platform + toc_parser as jama; requires a logged-in subscriber session. JCR Otorhinolaryngology #1.

nature.name: Nature
nature._note: Nature is not treated as a subscription here; abstract + whatever body content Nature serves on the article page is captured. PDF + audio + video left off (paywall + not implemented). wiki_ingest_all=false: the operator feeds the GPT reading guide first, then designates which articles' raw enters wiki (drop into $JOURNAL_INBOX).

science.name: Science
science.title_selectors: h1.article__headline, h1.core-title, main h1, article h1
science._note: Science is not treated as a subscription here. TOC source is the AAAS RSS endpoint instead of the HTML toc page — the HTML TOC and article pages are behind Cloudflare bot challenge, but the RSS endpoint passes server-side fetch and is namespace-rich (prism:doi / dc:type / dc:date). Article HTML pages still need a browser sync XHR with a Cloudflare-cleared session. Weekly Friday cadence (cover date typically Thursday/Friday). Atypon Literatum platform (same as AIM/JAMA). wiki_ingest_all=false: the operator feeds the GPT reading guide first, then designates which articles' raw enters wiki via --dois + --force-ingest-all.

lancet.name: The Lancet
lancet.title_selectors: h1.article-header__title, h1.toc__item__title, main h1, article h1
lancet._note: Lancet is not treated as a subscription here. TOC source is the Elsevier RDF/RSS endpoint at /rssfeed/lancet_current.xml — the HTML /journals/lancet/issue/current page is gated by Cloudflare bot challenge that the sync-XHR layer cannot solve, but the RSS endpoint passes server-side fetch and carries dc:identifier (DOI), prism:section (article type), prism:volume / prism:number (vol/issue), and rss:description (~150-700 char abstract excerpt). Article HTML pages also Cloudflare-gated; a browser with a Cloudflare-cleared session may pass — fall back to RSS-description-as-abstract when body extraction fails. Weekly Saturday cadence (cover date Sat; online Thu/Fri). Elsevier ScienceDirect platform. PII = Publisher Item Identifier; URL form `PIIS0140-6736(YY)NNNNN-X`. wiki_ingest_all=false: the operator feeds the GPT reading guide first, then designates which articles' raw enters wiki via --dois + --force-ingest-all.

bmj.name: BMJ
bmj.title_selectors: h1.highwire-cite-title, h1#page-title, main h1, article h1
bmj._note: BMJ is not treated as a subscription here. TOC source is `/content/current` which 302-redirects to the current issue (e.g. /content/393/8487?current-issue=y); fetchHtmlSync follows the 302 transparently — no need to hardcode volume/issue. Server-side fetch returns HTTP 200 with no Cloudflare gate (unlike Lancet/Science), so HTML TOC parses directly. ~53 articles per issue across Drupal-powered HighWire Press platform. DOI lives in data-pisa-master="bmj;bmj.{id}" attribute → 10.1136/bmj.{id}. Section grouping via h2.toc-heading[id] preceding li.toc-item siblings (DOM order, no nesting). Article body extraction may hit subscription wall for Research/Education types but Editorial/Comment/News/Obituary are typically free-to-read. Weekly Thursday cadence (UK Thu = Fri morning locally). wiki_ingest_all=false: the operator feeds the GPT reading guide first, then designates which articles' raw enters wiki via --dois + --force-ingest-all. RSS alternative at feeds.bmj.com/bmj/recent is rolling 25-article recent feed, NOT issue-bounded — issue-based parser is the right primitive for the journal-toc workflow. BMJ Vol/Issue numbering anchors: Vol 392 starts 8479=2026-01-10; Vol 393 starts 8485=2026-04-04; Vol 393 Issue 8487=2026-05-02. Future bundler enhancement: capture volume/issue from current TOC URL (302-resolved /content/{vol}/{issue}?current-issue=y) and emit into per-issue frontmatter.

jasn.name: Journal of the American Society of Nephrology
jasn.title_selectors: h1.ejp-article-title, h1.article-title, .article-title h1, .article-title, article h1, main h1
jasn._note: JASN requires a logged-in subscriber session. LWW / Wolters Kluwer ejp (Ovid) platform. Monthly cadence. TOC currenttoc.aspx is ASP.NET server-rendered — sync XHR returns the full article markup with no Cloudflare gate (verified 2026-05-21, ~525 KB, 20 articles). TOC DOM: div.article-list contains h3 section headings (Editorial / Basic Research / Clinical Research / Mechanisms of Kidney Diseases / Clinical Nephrology Insights / Innovator Corner / Designing Clinical Trials / Perspective), h4 subsection headings (Chronic Kidney Disease / Cystic Kidney Disease / Diabetes and the Kidney / Dialysis / Glomerular and Tubulointerstitial Diseases) and one <article> element per article. parseJASN_TOC walks h3/h4/article in document order: h3 -> section, bare h4 -> subtype, article -> emit. DOI 10.1681/ASN.NNNNNNNNNN lives in the <article> innerHTML (regex-extracted, uppercased); article_url is the absolute /jasn/fulltext/{year}/{issue}/{slug}.{N}.aspx link. Article page: title h1.ejp-article-title, abstract div.ejp-article-text-abstract (research articles only; editorials/perspectives have none), body #ArticleBody. LWW emits almost no citation_* meta except citation_doi. Wired 2026-05-21 mega.md-only (fetch_pdf/audio/supplementary=false, wiki_ingest_all=false); JASN NEJM-style full-media ingest is a future enhancement. wiki_ingest_all=false: the operator feeds the GPT reading guide first, then designates which articles' raw enters wiki via --dois + --force-ingest-all.

cjasn.name: Clinical Journal of the American Society of Nephrology
cjasn.title_selectors: h1.ejp-article-title, h1.article-title, .article-title h1, .article-title, article h1, main h1
cjasn._note: CJASN requires a logged-in subscriber session (monthly nephrology journal). Same LWW/Wolters Kluwer platform as JASN, so it reuses toc_parser=jasn: the parser handles LWW's current 'omni' TOC markup (div.omni-toc__heading section labels + article.omni-card cards, title from the card's h3) and accepts both 10.1681 (JASN) and 10.2215 (CJASN) DOIs. Monthly. mega.md-only (fetch_pdf/audio/supplementary=false, wiki_ingest_all=false) — same policy as JASN: GPT reading guide first, then the operator designates raw ingest via --dois + --force-ingest-all.

drugs.name: Drugs
drugs._note: Drugs (Adis / Springer Nature) monthly. Requires a logged-in subscriber session (full body extractable when authenticated). TOC URL points to specific issue (e.g., 86-6); bundler should be re-pointed each month to the new latest issue (manual until auto-detect added). Article cards: article.app-card-open with h2.app-card-open__heading > a (DOI from href, type from span.c-meta__type, OA from .c-meta__item textContent match 'Open access'). citation_volume/issue/page meta present on article pages.

jfda.name: Journal of Food and Drug Analysis
jfda._note: JFDA (Taiwan FDA; bepress Digital Commons; fully OA CC BY-NC-ND). Server-side HTML TOC (toc_format=html, toc_parser=jfda) — NO Chrome Beta / subscriber session needed; DOI deterministic from bepress article id (10.38212/2224-6614.<id>), so home/issue TOC alone yields doi+title+section+pdf. toc_url = journal home (shows current issue); re-point to a volNN/issM URL for a specific past issue.

ki.name: Kidney International
ki._note: Kidney International (ISN/Elsevier ScienceDirect). TOC = Elsevier RDF/RSS /current.rss, a single issue (prism:volume/number constant; dc:identifier DOI 10.1016/j.kint.*, prism:section, description abstract ~250-650c). Crossref deposits NO abstracts for Elsevier so the RSS <description> IS the abstract source; step-2a Crossref is a no-op backstop. Scheduled --toc-only (server-side, abstract-only reading-guide, no warm tab). Not treated as a subscription here; full text on designated articles only (Step-2).

ajkd.name: American Journal of Kidney Diseases
ajkd._note: American Journal of Kidney Diseases (NKF/Elsevier ScienceDirect). TOC = Elsevier RDF/RSS /current.rss (single issue; dc:identifier DOI 10.1053/j.ajkd.*, prism:section, description abstract). Same Elsevier parser + abstract-source rules as Kidney International. Scheduled --toc-only. Not treated as a subscription here; full text on designated articles only.

ndt.name: Nephrology Dialysis Transplantation
ndt._note: NDT (OUP/Silverchair). OUP RSS + issue pages are bot-blocked (404/403), so TOC = Crossref journal-works for ISSN 1460-2385, newest first, filtered from-pub-date = run_date - toc_window_days (rolling ~monthly window; OUP online-first lacks issue assignment, so NOT a numbered issue). Abstracts: Crossref ~60% deposited; the rest need a logged-in subscriber session (designated Step-2). Scheduled --toc-only (server-side).

kidney360.name: Kidney360
kidney360._note: Kidney360 (ASN, OPEN ACCESS). ASN/Atypon RSS + issue pages bot-blocked, so TOC = Crossref journal-works ISSN 2641-7650, from-pub-date rolling ~monthly window (toc_window_days=35 (monthly cadence); lower volume than NDT). OA => full text is freely available (PMC / journal site) for designated ingest; abstracts via Crossref/EuropePMC where deposited. Scheduled --toc-only (server-side).
